exposure: initial serum ß- human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) level
Initial serum ß-human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) level
type 2 position of the gestational sac
outcome: Treatment success of local methotrexate (MTX) injection for caesarean scar pregnancy (CSP)
cohort: 47 patients diagnosed with CSP, of whom 30 received local MTX injection
finding: A high initial serum ß-hCG level (≥ 47,000 mIU/ml) was independently associated with treatment failure of local methotrexate injection for caesarean scar pregnancy.
